answer: In Proof of Agent, trust propagates through bounded random walks on the attestation graph, while conductance measures the probability that walk mass crosses a cut. A sybil cluster with few honest attestations creates a sparse external cut, trapping mass through low conductance and thereby limiting its aggregate voting weight. Min-cut transitivity bounds prevent multiple clusters from composing disproportionate influence; labels such as walnut, hollow, and prism confer no trust.
